title: Azure OpenAI Recognizer Options
description: Azure OpenAI realtime transcription STT options. Only applies when recognizer vendor is 'azureopenai'.

apiKey.description: Azure OpenAI resource key. Overrides credentials configured in jambonz.

deployment.description: Azure STT deployment name. Overrides the deployment configured in the credential.

model.description: Model family behind the deployment. Selects turn detection and the fields sent; inferred from the deployment name when unset.

prompt.description: Prompt to guide the recognition model.

languages.description: Language hints for the 'gpt-live-transcribe' family, which takes a list rather than a single code (e.g. ['en','fr']). Overrides the recognizer language.

keywords.description: Literal term hints for the 'gpt-live-transcribe' family. Defaults to the recognizer's 'hints' when unset.

turn_detection.description: Server turn detection for the server-endpointed families ('gpt-4o-transcribe', 'gpt-4o-mini-transcribe', 'whisper-1').

eagerness.description: How eagerly a turn is ended (semantic_vad only).

prefix_padding_ms.description: Milliseconds of audio to include before detected speech.

silence_duration_ms.description: Milliseconds of silence to detect end of speech.

idle_timeout_ms.description: server_vad only: milliseconds of silence after which the server commits the buffer.

vadMode.description: Local VAD aggressiveness (0-3). Used only with the client-endpointed families ('gpt-live-transcribe', 'gpt-realtime-whisper').

vadSilenceMs.description: Milliseconds of silence to detect end-of-speech for local VAD. Used only with the client-endpointed families.

vadVoiceMs.description: Milliseconds of voice to detect start-of-speech for local VAD. Used only with the client-endpointed families.
